items.description: Disposal of storm debris (roof timber, glass pane, green waste, root ball <1 m3)
items.rationale: Combined position, but every element is material arising under 5.2.1(a)-(b) (root mass under 1 m3), so 7.1.10 is satisfied. Priced from reference case levels: approx. 60 + 32 + 55 + 40.

items.description: Disposal of ground material (soil, topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is excluded from clearance by 5.2.1(d) and 4.3(d); it is a standalone disposal with no reinstatement or making good, so 5.2.2 is not met. Reference case showed 0 for the same items.
